notes.title: Improved controls are coming soon
notes.notes:
Our team is busy with another major update for the Dark Tree demo — and it’s coming soon!

Updated and improved controls would be one of the key changes. We aim to add the option to manually pick the target, thus giving the player a bit more control over the course of action.

We can’t wait to show you the progress being made with the demo, but for now, please, add Dark Tree to your wishlist — it would help us greatly.

notes.title: Animated character arts
notes.notes:
No time to waste — the development of Dark Tree moves on rapidly. We are happy to show you the example of character animation. As you can guess, all of these gorgeous arts are now animated and can perform various things during dialogues.

Currently we are busy with adding new features and improvements. When the time comes, we'll surely share more info with you. Stay tuned for these kind of quality of life features!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.31a
notes.notes:
Our team has been busy with swift updates and bugfixes. Dark Tree demo is now updated to version 0.31a with tons of new content: dialogues for a bunch of NPCs, new ambient music and a special ending screen for those who've beaten the demo. We sincerely hope that all these changes would greatly improve your gaming and user experience. Give it a try and share your thoughts!

Full changelist:

— New dialogue phrases for NPCs
— Added the new musical track
— Added the ending screen
— Added the access to buffs and talents
— Made some visual changes to battle arena #1
— Improved the quality of textures for different locations
— Talents and skills moved to inventory screen
— Fixed the bug with music volume
— Fixed the bug with black screen
— Fixed the bug with screen resolution
— Fixed the bug with two enemy death animations
— Fixed the bug with default language
— Fixed the bug with game restart
— Fixed the bug with menu not appearing after being killed
— Fixed the bug with portal in the end of the demo
— Different fixes regarding the localization
— Balanced a bunch of side-quests
